corinthians2.3.p1.b1.text: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?

corinthians2.3.p1.b2.text: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.

corinthians2.3.p1.b3.text: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry,

corinthians2.3.p1.b4.text: written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

corinthians2.3.p2.b1.text: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.

corinthians2.3.p2.b2.text: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.

corinthians2.3.p2.b3.text: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit;

corinthians2.3.p2.b4.text: for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

corinthians2.3.p3.b1.text: … came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,

corinthians2.3.p3.b2.text: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?

corinthians2.3.p3.b3.text: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!

corinthians2.3.p4.b1.text: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.

corinthians2.3.p4.b2.text: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.

corinthians2.3.p4.b3.text: And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.

corinthians2.3.p4.b4.text: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

corinthians2.3.p5.b1.text: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

corinthians2.3.p5.b2.text: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord,

corinthians2.3.p5.b3.text: are being transformed into His image

corinthians2.3.p5.b4.text: with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
